scope: Read-only analysis of existing festival tiles and saved GameView layout; no changes to source PNGs, importer metadata, scene, or the user's running Unity editor.
unityImportScope: Unity 6000.6.0f1 isolated project with copies of the 44 source PNGs and their original importer metadata. It does not directly inspect the running editor's texture cache.

unityImportResult.inference: No texture-resolution reduction or compressed runtime texture was found in the isolated import; bilinear filtering is active.

metadata.note: Standalone metadata includes compression=1, but its override is disabled; the isolated editor import produced RGB24.

previewImplementation.gridOrigin: row 1 at north, column 1 at west
previewImplementation.defaultView: Orthographic camera fits the complete tile grid into the GameView.

savedGameViewLayout.note: A saved editor layout, not a measurement of the user's current live GameView, monitor DPI, or zoom.

conclusion: Showing all tiles at once necessarily downscales the source and loses fine detail; saved GameView zoom adds further display scaling. The isolated import does not indicate a 1024-to-smaller texture import problem. The actual live GameView settings, display scaling, and any additional visual effects are unverified.

authoringTool.nativePixelView: The 1:1 control sets canvas zoom to 1 / EditorGUIUtility.pixelsPerPoint; use middle-drag to inspect other locations.
authoringTool.zoomValidation: Verified in the isolated Unity authoring test recorded by unityImportReceipt.

limitations: Source SHA and coordinate receipts establish the selected tiles and import; they do not establish that valid world boundaries or original 4:3 mapping are known.
No screenshot or visual observation of the user's current live GameView was collected.
PNG source details cannot all be seen at once at native pixels on a smaller display; zoom reveals a portion, it does not add details.
